Vertically integrated (feedlots → slaughter → deboning); units Nova Canaã do Norte–MT (750 hd/day), Ji-Paraná–RO (1,100 hd/day, deboning 4,000 pieces/day); export office Itajaí–SC. Chilled/frozen cuts (Brazilian + differentiated export cuts), offal, feedlot-finished beef. Markets: Russia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Palestine, other Middle East/Orient. Family group (Bellincanta). Certifications: SIF/MAPA; export habilitations per destination. No risk flags found.

Emails from official site footer/catalogs. Alts: frisa@frisa.com.br, frisaeco@frisa.com.br; SAC 0800 703 3222; site has an 'Exportação' section (no dedicated export email). Founded 1968, ~2,918 employees; units Nanuque–MG, Teixeira de Freitas–BA, Niterói–RJ; own retail butcher shops ES/MG/RJ. BEST beef-derivative portfolio in this file: jerked beef (charque-style), canned beef/Enlatados (see carne-enlatada entry), hamburgers (see hamburguesas entry), sausages/linguiça toscana (see salchichas entry), frios/embutidos, bacon, carpaccio, tender (see embutidos-fiambres entry). Fresh/chilled beef cuts (Grã Filé, Bife!, Felicittá brands). Certifications: SIF/MAPA. No risk flags found.

No export email found (contato@naturafrig.com.br appears only in CNPJ registry records — registry-listed, NOT official-site-confirmed). Plants: Rochedo–MS (HQ), Pirapozinho–SP, Nova Andradina–MS, Barra do Bugres–MT. Among Brazil's five largest frigoríficos; 5,001–10,000 employees; 30 years in beef. Chilled/frozen cuts; lines Naturafrig, Gold Quality, Festeja; multi-species plant (horse/sheep/goat/pork secondary); animal oils/fats (óleos e gorduras animais). 30+ countries; Indonesia-approved Sept 2026 (one of 73 plants). Certifications: SIF/MAPA. No risk flags found.

Email from official site contact page. Legal: Barra Mansa Comércio de Carnes e Derivados Ltda. (Oranges family group). 5th-generation beef family (since 1887); top-10 Brazilian packer; cold storage 1,200 t chilled + 1,000 t frozen; supplies Carrefour, Pão de Açúcar. Premium chilled/frozen cuts, offal, omaso, tripas, differentiated/export cuts. 90 countries: China, USA, EU, Hong Kong, Russia, Georgia, Peru, Paraguay, Uruguay, Argentina, Israel, Sweden, Ghana, Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, UK. STRONGEST compliance mid-size: BRC Food Safety grade AA + Certified Humane (slaughter & transport) + ISO 14001. SIF/MAPA. No risk flags found.

No export email found (registry lists only fiscal.corporavo@primafoods.com.br — fiscal/accounting). Renamed from Mataboi Alimentos in 2020; founded 1949. Plants: Araçatuba–SP, Santa Fé de Goiás–GO. Chilled/frozen cuts, deboned beef, meat products, by-products. Official site domain unconfirmed in this pass. Controlled by JBJ Investimentos (José Batista Júnior) — different Batista family branch from JBS's Batista family; do not conflate. Certifications: SIF/MAPA. No risk flags found.

Grupo Minerva (via Athena Foods) — separate operating entity (Colombia). Minerva acquired Red Cárnica 2015 (Ciénaga de Oro) and Frigorífico Vijagual 2020 (Bucaramanga, Santander). No export email published; phone from a 2021 university thesis on Red Cárnica. 2 slaughter+deboning plants ~1,300 hd/day (Ciénaga de Oro ~600, Bucaramanga ~700). 🎯 Exporta a Cuba (markets include Cuba); also China (both plants authorized), Chile, Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Lebanon), Russia, Peru, Hong Kong, Vietnam. Brands: Cabaña Las Lilas, Estancia 92, Pul. Certifications: INVIMA export-authorized; BRCGS AA+ (Ciénaga de Oro, 2025); HACCP; Colombia FMD-free with vaccination (China protocol). ⚠️ Minerva suspended slaughter at both plants Aug 2023 (FX + price drop) — later resumed; largest beef exporter of Colombia.

Email from Contraloría General de la República audit report 2022-2023 on Frigosinú. Founded 1978; Class 1 export-type plant; ~500 hd/day; Fedegán/FNG 45.9% shareholder. Bovine AND buffalo slaughter/deboning; chilled/frozen carcasses, specialty cuts, vacuum-packed meat; offal; tallow/sebo, hides, meat/bone/blood meal. 'Carnes Frías' derivatives plant (since 2009): embutidos (see embutidos-fiambres entry). First Colombian beef to Qatar (16 t container via Cartagena); markets: Venezuela, Russia, UAE; 18 markets open to Colombian beef. Certifications: INVIMA export-authorized, HACCP. Ongoing land/wetland litigation (Humedal Furatena) — reputational, not sanitary.

No export email published. HQ Bogotá (Cra 46 #93-71); 5 plants: Frigoriente (Villavicencio), Frigosabanas (Corozal), Frigomedio (La Dorada), Frigonorte (San Cayetano), Fricolsa (Valparaíso); built 1998-2003 with Fondo Nacional del Ganado (FNG holds 78.6%). Bovine slaughter + deboning; carcasses, cuts, offal; retail seal. Corozal + La Dorada export-authorized (e.g. Lebanon/Halal). Certifications: INVIMA export-authorized plants; Decreto 1500 track. ⚠️ EN REORGANIZACIÓN (Colombian insolvency reorganization, Law 1116) — financial distress flag; not a closure but a caution.

No export email (corporate contact only); no export-desk phone published. Business unit 'Cárnicos': Industria de Alimentos Zenú (~COP 3 trillion sales 2023). Beef slaughter + deboning (Envigado plant 034DM, Aguachica plant 002B, La Ceja); processed meats, embutidos, maduradas, hamburguesas (see embutidos-fiambres and hamburguesas entries) — Zenú, Ranchera brands; pork too. Beef exports: Peru (main buyer, 25 t/week program), Lebanon, Jordan, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Vietnam, Hong Kong; previously Russia, Curaçao. Certifications: INVIMA export-authorized; SENASA Peru habilitation. No specific risk flags.

No export email published. Bovine slaughter line 80 hd/hour (~200,000 hd/year capacity); carcasses, cuts. UAE-authorized; part of Colombia's 18 open beef markets. Certifications: INVIMA export-authorized plant 073BD. Note: Colombian company — not the Cuban city of Camagüey.

No email published; official site under construction as of 2026-10-03. 14 ha plant (carretera a Cotoca km 10½); leader of Bolivian meat industry; largest cold-storage capacity in Bolivia. Certifications: HACCP, ISO 22000; SENASAG export-authorized; Bolivia OMSA FMD-free. ⚠️ Bolivian government suspended beef exports to China since Feb 2025 (domestic price controls) — applies to all exporters; Chile/Egypt negotiations ongoing.

One of 3 Bolivian plants authorized to export beef to Russia. Certifications: SENASAG; BPM/POES. ⚠️ Bolivia China export suspension since Feb 2025 applies (all exporters).
